purpose: Define the exact environment obligations that must be satisfied before the TinyLlama public trace command can become a real execution rather than another blocked launch.

python.recommended: Python 3.10-3.12 for broad torch/transformers binary compatibility; current capsule is probed by tools/public_trace_env_preflight.py.

packages.torch: installed with CUDA if named-hardware timing is required; CPU is acceptable only for trace capture sanity, not performance promotion
packages.transformers: >=4.57 recommended for the current AttentionInterface/AttentionMaskInterface semantics used by the capture wrapper; TinyLlama basic inference says >=4.34 but this trace wrapper has stricter capture needs
packages.huggingface_hub: required for reviewed model download or cache inspection
packages.safetensors: required/recommended because the selected model tree uses model.safetensors
packages.accelerate: recommended for device placement when running the 2.2 GB model
packages.hf_xet: recommended if downloading from HF Xet-backed files

hf_cache.model_size_seen_online: 2.2 GB; leave several GB free for cache, temp, and provenance outputs

performance_promotion_still_requires: named CUDA/HIP/accelerator model and driver/runtime versions
dense baseline through current PyTorch SDPA/Flash/Flex/Paged-style serving baselines where applicable
end-to-end prefill+decode wall-clock with mask/cache/layout construction costs included
